verdict: ACCEPTED (Score: 8.8/10 - UNCAPPED). Commit 9f8fcb1576e3d78f86fbb3054def9ff2249c9f02 delivers complete cross-platform release packaging and distribution parity across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. On Windows, scripts/build_windows_installer.py generates WiX MSI sources exactly matching reference/MissionPlanner/wix/Program.cs and Drivers.cs (retaining UpgradeCode {625389D7-EB3C-4d77-A5F6-A285CF99437D}, .tlog/.bin/.param/.waypoints file associations, start menu and desktop shortcuts, registry entries under HKCU\Software\MichaelOborne\MissionPlanner, and 32/64-bit DPInst signed driver installation sequence), alongside portable ZIP distribution assembly with SHA-256 checksums. findings.title: scripts/build_windows_installer.py uses Optional and Tuple type annotations without importing them from typing
findings.description: In scripts/build_windows_installer.py (lines 162-163), `extra_files: Optional[list] = None` and `-> Tuple[Path, str]` are used in `assemble_portable_zip`, but `Optional` and `Tuple` are not imported from `typing`. While Python 3.14 defers annotation evaluation via PEP 649, Python versions <= 3.13 or tools inspecting `typing.get_type_hints()` will raise a NameError. Should add `from typing import Optional, Tuple` to scripts/build_windows_installer.py for compatibility across all Python runtimes.
